title: Pin the timezone and DST test matrix
description:
Pin resolveWindow with table-driven tests over an injected now: UTC; America/Los_Angeles including the 2026-03-08 spring-forward and 2026-11-01 fall-back dates; Asia/Tokyo; Australia/Lord_Howe (30-minute offset); day-start variants 00:00, 04:00, 23:30; boundary inclusion (start inclusive, end exclusive); a rolling 24h window crossing a DST change; per-source timestamp parsing feeding the window filter.

Done when: the full matrix passes in Jest and a future refactor of the internals cannot change observable window behavior.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Pinned table-driven matrix in tests/unit/sentiment/windows.spec.ts over injected now: UTC, America/Los_Angeles (2026-03-08 spring-forward incl. 02:30 gap clamp and 2026-11-01 fall-back incl. 01:30 ambiguity resolved earlier), Asia/Tokyo, Australia/Lord_Howe (30-minute offset), day-start 00:00/04:00/23:30, start-inclusive/end-exclusive boundaries, rolling 24h crossing DST, and per-source timestamp parsing (ISO-Z, epoch ms, RFC3339+ms) feeding the window filter. 23 tests. Outcome: green.
